prompt:
A minimalist recipe card illustration for chamomile tea. Flat-lay top-down view of a single hand-thrown ceramic cup filled with golden-amber chamomile tea, placed slightly off-center (upper left). Scattered around the cup on a bone #F7EFE2 surface: five or six small chamomile flowers (white petals, bright yellow centers), two dried stems with tiny leaves, and one honey-drizzle smear in soft amber. The composition breathes — at least half the image is clean empty bone-colored surface. No utensils, no saucers, no text, no steam.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration — flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradients. Flower shapes and leaves have clean confident silhouettes, not painterly brushstrokes. NO watercolor bleeds, NO paper grain, NO sketchy lines. The cup has a subtle sage-green glazed rim. Warm diffuse morning light from upper left casts a faint soft shadow below the cup. Feels fresh, calm, inviting — like the user could reach in and start assembling their own tea. Recipe card thumbnail — subject must read at small sizes.
